ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit
(detached house) District symbols as shown on Map No. 1-K

in the area bounded by:
West Superior Street; A line 150 ft. west of and parallel to North Kilpatrick Avenue;
the public alley next south of and parallel to West Superior Street; a line 200 ft. west of

and parallel to North Kilpatrick Avenue.

To those of a RT-4 Residential Two Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 4717-19 W. Superior Street
